messages.message: How long a player remains on the transfer list
Days. If the player is not sold within this period, the duration is extended by the same number of days.
Calculate market value automatically. Market value is based on the player's actual strength.
if market value is to be calculated automatically.
Minimum number of players in the team. Players cannot be sold if this would reduce the squad below the minimum size.
Maximum number of permitted transactions between two users within the last 30 days.
Minimum market value for transfer news
From this market value, a player is considered a big name regardless of the fee. 0 disables this criterion.
From this strength onwards, a move is published as a significant transfer. 0 disables this criterion.
From this fee onwards, the move is published as transfer news. 0 disables this criterion.
Players within this share of the most valuable active players also trigger transfer news.
Maximum number of CPU clubs that check new transfer offers per system run.
Maximum number of simultaneously open transfer offers from a CPU club.
Maximum number of simultaneously open offers from CPU clubs for one player.
Percentage chance of a one-time talent change of +1 or -1 after a completed transfer.
CPU clubs are automatically topped up to this minimum amount.
